body:
## Disposition

**Bathcat / needs_followup / OPEN DRAFT / DO NOT MERGE**

`Bathcat-Authored: true`

T retains final authority. Bathcat did not approve, mark ready, promote, or merge. A wholly fresh Mennonite must audit the exact live head before disposition.

## Immutable delivery boundary

- Base: `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd` (`origin/main`)
- Prior audited head (Mennonite `REVISE`): `121e2f8c6195f18a7338a4092b0fdeebaf997833`
- Repaired exact head: `2e0b266dec6f296117c4ae70197a820ba2f2204d`
- Branch: `kb/shadows-over-camelot-rules-components`
- Target: English **2005 first/release retail base game**, *Shadows over Camelot*, BGG 15062, Days of Wonder, Serge Laget and Bruno Cathala.
- Excluded: 2015/reprint and later Asmodee printing law except explicit comparison; *Merlin's Company*; Sir Bedivere and all promos; translations; anniversary/fan variants; replacements; unofficial summaries/lists/apps; Tabletopia/BGA/digital implementations.

## Authority and revision matrix

1. **2005 Book of Quests — acquired official release authority.** 16 pages; 2,306,806 bytes; SHA-256 `2e96d255acd1ed17f0a345608531aa45e9f4aa0d180625b9ab0f7e17d0c0cde9`; created/modified 2005-05-26.
2. **FAQ 1.0 — acquired dated official clarification.** Dated 2005-10-12; 6 pages; 309,029 bytes; SHA-256 `2f4ab8d1756e5743dd7cf12802bebb371dcf08141b448d9867adce5ca7a90709`. Applied only to named base cases; Sir Bedivere paragraph excluded; no universal precedence doctrine invented.
3. **2015-served rulebook — later comparison only.** 20 pages; 10,567,489 bytes; SHA-256 `1e3f5abb3938be9c7ede217405f96b750a92234c2e2ad962d9fff77408a3d950`; metadata identifies reprint 2012, modified 2015; footer `7202-P07`, copyright 2005-2015. It is not backdated into release law.
4. **Original Rules lead — unresolved.** `sc_rules_en.pdf` returned HTTP 403 on CDN and www host; exact Wayback CDX query returned `[]`. That is not proof of absence.
5. Current FAQ portal returned Access Denied directly/browser; retrieval aid reports current 404. Historical web-support inventory remains open.

## Component arithmetic and governing ledger

The only complete acquired publisher inventory is later and therefore provisional:

- Cards: `84 White + 76 Black + 8 Loyalty = 168`; White `69 Standard + 15 Special`; Black `64 Standard + 12 Special`.
- Miniatures: `12 Siege Engines + 3 relics + 4 Saxons + 4 Picts + 7 Knights = 30`.
- Other listed physical objects under the declared convention: `1 master board + 3 double-sided Quest boards + 16 double-sided swords + 7 coats + 7 d6 + 1 d8 + 2 booklets = 37`.
- Provisional later-print physical total: `168 + 30 + 37 = 235`.
- The online number printed on the Rules is not a separate object; insert/tray, faces, sides, surfaces, and multipart assumptions are excluded.

Framework is recorded for Rules/Book of Quests; Camelot/Round Table/Siege; every base Quest side; seven base Knights/powers; White/Black/Loyalty classes; Fight/Grail/Merlin/special flows; swords; siege/warrior/relic pieces; D8 combat; life/hand/placement; and Traitor procedures. First-print quantities plus complete identity/text/mapping/face/side/surface denominators remain **UNKNOWN**, so no percentage or composite is reported.

## Rules, reception, and mechanic judgment

Six operative rule records cover setup/scaling and the exact three-player recommendation; mandatory Evil/Heroic phases and communication; travel/solo abandonment/death; Grail, Excalibur, Black Knight, Lancelot→Dragon, Pict/Saxon, Camelot siege, and sword frameworks; set/tie/consequence/permanence rules; accusation/revealed-Traitor procedure; and immediate/end-sword victory branches. Later-rulebook procedures are always labeled comparison where release Rules are missing.

### Mennonite `REVISE` repair map

- `rules/actions.okf.md`: corrected a lost Pict/Saxon War to two Siege Engines + one Black sword, one Life lost by each present Knight, return to Camelot, and perpetual reset; split Combat-Quest termination/comparison from Black Knight/Lancelot/Dragon patterns and Black-side capacities; repaired both Holy Grail placement branches and the separate Dark Forest state.
- FAQ II/III: encoded optional-per-Knight Convocation, remote Heroism, Dark Forest placement/nonblocking/after-end Siege conversion, one-Merlin latest-Standard-Black removal and its Excalibur/twelfth-Siege limits, Lady of the Lake's no-present-Knight branch, and the Dragon/Excalibur-only no-Knight completion consequences.
- FAQ IV/VI/VII: encoded Arthur's timing/simultaneous forced exchange restrictions, Kay's Siege exclusion and unrestricted Quest-resolution Fight value, Percival + Armor's ordered two-card inspection and Evil choice, accusation eligibility switching off below both thresholds, and the unmasked Traitor's Fate/Reinforcements immunity. Sir Bedivere alone remains excluded.
- Repair commit scope: five existing rule records plus deterministic `TELEMETRY.md`; 66 insertions, 7 deletions. No visual, reception, scout-ledger, arithmetic, source-role, or unknown-denominator bytes changed by the repair commit.

Two written independent witnesses are bounded to their testimony:

- Tom Vasel, RPGnet, 2005-06-15; 29,990 bytes; SHA-256 `347b23a68671e56ce71e0ccb139b31cf23aad01c506d5513cc4a2d839d3aa4e6`.
- Quinns, Shut Up & Sit Down, 2012-11-26; origin 403, bounded text via retrieval aid; 9,979 bytes; SHA-256 `45784d93836c0407c2b1e99a7194d610be11878b328af3f3e02bb6ca6d470402`; expansion explicitly unplayed.

Controlled better-if mappings are limited to onboarding, player interaction, and strategic depth. No unsupported quarterbacking, elimination, downtime, randomness, or 3/7 scaling conclusion is asserted.

Mechanics retain cooperative + semi-cooperative because loyal team law and possible opposing Traitor support both. This is **not deck-building**: cards flow through shared piles/hands, with no acquisition into a persistent personal deck.

## Lawful visual replacement

The four synthetic canonical paths were overwritten in place with noncontiguous reduced excerpts from official **2005 Book of Quests** pages 4, 6, 9, and 12. No 2015, expansion, promo, or translation visual was used.

- `01-setup.webp`: 300x214, 11,436 bytes, SHA-256 `6fa945d488ffb8ef960cf87d82aa932ea502e267553d1a82913508cab37e0fe9`
- `02-loop.webp`: 300x230, 15,188 bytes, SHA-256 `9e3d0940c8ffd2a29d086fc92994263214d5b8fc1baf2a5b9d5f256d50a0fadb`
- `03-tension.webp`: 300x236, 14,986 bytes, SHA-256 `79ecd504353ac14a0c270a6964e618c67378e347430c81b2b6cef5a6be84cde8`
- `04-endgame.webp`: 300x382, 16,484 bytes, SHA-256 `436e6ef018d92e510d2f45a9c0067536cfbd42d8c7b77969bfc5e57bb8609519`
- Contact: 560x500, 42,870 bytes, SHA-256 `47536d18b9c53d8d9bc20cc17733dfdae3286a11eec8529063e7c0a0e775fda9`

Poppler 25.03.0 at 100 dpi + FFmpeg 7.1.5 crop/Lanczos/libwebp/metadata stripping is fully recorded in the manifest. Visual inspection found distinct, uncorrupted base-game panels; ordinary prose is below practical replacement quality. Rights remain with Days of Wonder/respective holders; no license inferred.

## Paths and gates

Changed canonical game tree now has exactly 12 OKF records: index, sources, scout, six rules, two reception, and visual packet; plus five in-place WebP replacements, generated corpus index, and telemetry.

Passed before commit:

- focused validation of the five changed rule records
- provenance tests
- `node scripts/generate-index.mjs`
- `node scripts/validate-okf.mjs` — 2,619 files clean + index fresh
- prescribed intake/provenance/fail-closed/visual Node suite — 36 passed, 1 fixture skipped, 0 failed

Passed against committed head:

- `node scripts/validate-intake.mjs --base origin/main`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`

Exact-head CI: `validate` **SUCCESS** on `2e0b266dec6f296117c4ae70197a820ba2f2204d` — [run 30663832933, job 91266041301](https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30663832933/job/91266041301).

## Residual help required

1. Physical English 2005 first-retail copy with SKU/UPC/copyright/lot/printing markers and line-by-line nonreplacement inventory.
2. Immutable original Rules booklet, Book of Quests, and any player aid/card reference with official archive chain.
3. Complete historical official FAQ/web-support inventory and explicit release→FAQ→reprint version bridge.
4. Licensed base-only hidden card/Loyalty/Quest/board/D8 identity/text/face denominator without replacement-quality mirroring.

Until those external authorities are supplied, all 12 records remain `needs_followup`; this PR remains **OPEN + DRAFT + DO NOT MERGE**. Receiver: Judge, then a wholly fresh Mennonite bound only to repaired head `2e0b266dec6f296117c4ae70197a820ba2f2204d`.
